text:
sam: kicking off a tiny canary for the dim-sketch + advisory backpressure header in 45m. want console heatmap + oncall eyes.
ivy: short flow?
sam: ingress: prefer header `X-RWI-Embed-Dims`; if missing sample first 6 vectors (sketch) -> compute p50/p95 -> label `dim_tag=narrow/typical/wide` -> choose route: fast|chunk-split|fallback-smallmodel -> if over soft threshold send advisory header instead of 413 and increment token-bucket counter.
ravi: what's the advisory header and format?
sam: `X-RWI-Embed-Backpressure: hold=75ms;reason=wide_dim;policy=v1`
maria: console asks: heatmap with tenant rows and dim-buckets cols (p50/p95) + advice_rate sparkline. clickable sample payloads needed.
perf-bot: sketch sampling adds ~0.22ms median to ingress path on our g5 clusters. thresholds: p50>1536 or p95>3584 => wide (config flaggable).
sre: deploy plan?
perf-bot: canary 5% for 1h. watch metrics: `embed.dim_tag.count`, `embed.route.fast_rate`, `embed.advice.count`, `embed.hard_413.count`. rollback if any tenant reports hard 413 during canary.
ivy: quota semantics proposal: advisory tier uses a redis token-bucket per-tenant. clients get `Backpressure` header when tokens low. after N ignored advices escalate to hard 413.
sam: mismatch between header and probe recorded as `dim_header_mismatch` event. header remains optional.
maria: UI: add opt-in toggle per tenant, live pane showing advice_ratio and p95 latency slices. prototype by EOD tomorrow.
ravi: doc snippet for changelog please.
sam: example curl:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "X-RWI-Embed-Dims: 4096" \
  -d '{"inputs": [[...],[...]]}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings
```
response headers may include `X-RWI-Embed-Backpressure: hold=100ms;reason=wide_dim` or `X-RWI-Embed-Route: chunk_split` or `X-RWI-Embed-Route: fast`.
perf-bot: add k8s loadtest with two tenants (narrow-heavy, mixed-wide) and assert fastpath p50 unchanged for narrow tenant.
sre: add alert: any tenant with hard_413 > 0 during canary -> pager and auto-rollback.
console-bot: will ship prom metrics + structured event `embed.dim_sketch_event` to event-shipper with tags tenant_id, dim_tag, route, advisory_sent.
sam: launching canary in 45m. will update this thread. thanks :rocket:
